title: Idmodel
text: Simulate identified linear model in Simulink software, 1 input, 1 output, {Initial conditions} sets Initial conditions; {Identified model} sets the linear model to be simulated idss, {Add noise} and {Noise seed(s)} adds same noise to output for multiple simulations. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Identified model
params.values: Linear model to be simulated idss(-1,1,1,0,’Ts’,1) (default) | idss object | idgrey object | idpoly object | idtf object | idproc object

params.name: Initial conditions
params.values: Initial conditions 0 (default) | numeric vector | initialCondition object

params.name: Add noise
params.values: Add noise to simulated output on (default) | off

params.name: Noise seed(s)
params.values: Add same noise to output for multiple simulations [] (default) | nonnegative integer | vector
